visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a light blue T-shirt and black shorts, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a pink smartphone and gestures enthusiastically towards the camera. The background features an air conditioning unit and a neutral-colored wall with a bed visible. (2) She pulls on a black lanyard hanging around her neck, demonstrating its dual function as a charging cable. She brings the connector close to the camera, showcasing its texture. (3) She pulls the lanyard to its full length, demonstrating its adjustability. She shifts her posture, showing how the phone hangs at her hip. (4) The woman begins attaching various accessories to the lanyard's hook, including a hello kitty themed phone case, a large yellow sun plush keychain, and a purple character charm. (5) She attaches a small pink power bank to the lanyard and points at it while laughing. (6) She jumps and waves her arms, demonstrating the stability of the attached items while dancing in a playful manner. Yellow and white variety-show style text overlays flicker on the screen throughout the sequence.
